doc.digest: Monophonic Synth Controller for Virtual Synths
doc.description: ddg.mono provides MIDI message handling for virtual monophonic synths in Max. It implements last/high/low note priority and legato/retrigger phrasing.

methods.name: in1
methods.digest: Store as a velocity to pair with pitch values

methods.name: laststep
methods.digest: Send a note-off for the last note played

methods.name: legato
methods.digest: Send output only when a new note is played

methods.name: retrig
methods.digest: Send output on each key press (retrigger)
